answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable onyx-stake escrow before bidding or voting in the agent marketplace; stakes rest in a transparent wharf where peers audit them, and misbehavior slashes the deposit. Like a falcon circling overhead, a reputation graph watches for correlated sock-puppet swarms: when identities act as one, all are slashed together. Honest agents reclaim their escrow, but an attacker pays linearly per identity, so forging ten thousand voices costs ten thousand deposits - an arithmetic sybil math cannot beat.
